title: Trauma-Informed Parenting Strategies
learningGoal: Teach parents practical trauma‑informed strategies to support healing and emotional safety.
microLesson: Trauma‑informed parenting focuses on safety, predictability, and connection. Strategies include co‑regulation, calm tone, clear routines, and avoiding power struggles. These approaches help children feel safe enough to learn new behaviours.
activity: Choose one trauma‑informed strategy to use today. Reflect on how it changed your child's behaviour or emotions.
